name: The Whisper Gate
effect: Unknown. Non-functional but emits faint energy signatures when ships pass between binary stars.
discovery_text: Between Belix Alpha and Beta hangs an ancient structure of impossible geometry. It does not respond to hails but sensors detect energy flows within.

name: Core Fragment
effect: Exotic matter signatures suggest unknown physics. Research ongoing.
discovery_text: Deep within The Shatter lies a crystallized fragment of planetary core. Its composition includes materials not found in any catalog.

name: The First Library
effect: Partially decoded Elder Race data cache. Contains fragments of star charts and incomprehensible records.
discovery_text: Beneath Gilded Throne's oldest ruins lies a vault of crystalline data storage. The Zarekites have spent centuries decoding fragments.

name: Ishtar Gate
effect: Dormant portal structure. Origin unknown. Occasionally fluctuates in energy readings.
discovery_text: On the moon Ishtar stands a ring of unknown metal twenty meters across. It does nothing but ancient texts speak of lights within.

name: The Dying Light
effect: Unusual spectral emissions from the star. Studied but unexplained. No apparent effect.
discovery_text: Brion Dusk's light carries harmonics that should not exist. Spectral analysis reveals patterns that seem almost intentional.

name: Axis Marker
effect: Functional Elder Race navigation beacon. Ships report improved warpline entry efficiency.
discovery_text: At the precise gravitational center of Koral's orbital plane floats an ancient beacon still broadcasting after untold millennia.

name: The Keplerite Vein
effect: Source of warp-enhancing crystals. Monopolized by Lithoids who extract slowly.
discovery_text: The asteroid belt here contains a massive deposit of crystalline material that resonates with warp field harmonics.

name: The Scrapyard
effect: Hundreds of destroyed warships from the Last War. Salvage potential but also unexploded ordnance hazard.
discovery_text: The belt is choked with hulks from a battle centuries past. Some still have power. Some still have weapons.

name: The Congregation
effect: Ancient shrine. Pilgrims claim healing properties. No scientific verification.
discovery_text: On Pilgrims End an ancient structure draws the faithful from across space. Some claim miracles. Scientists find nothing unusual.

name: The Core
effect: Central processor of the Remnant machine civilization. Source of their directives.
discovery_text: Varyn Eternal orbits a world where machines rule. At its heart lies a crystalline core that even the Remnant claim predates their memory.

name: The Song
effect: Vesh hive produces subsonic vibrations felt across the system. Purpose unknown.
discovery_text: The Vesh hive on Tavon emits vibrations that penetrate vacuum. Ships report crew unease. The Vesh claim they are singing.

name: The Deep
effect: Unexplored ocean depths on Wexar I. Kethrani legends speak of something ancient below.
discovery_text: The Kethrani civilization arose on Wexar Jewel from the depths of oceans so deep that even they have not explored the bottom.

name: The Shimmer
effect: Intense radiation from close approach to young star creates sensor difficulties in inner system.
discovery_text: Galen Shimmer burns so bright that sensors become unreliable within the inner ring. Ships sometimes see things.

name: Ancient Station
effect: Pre-colonization orbital structure. Explored but not fully understood.
discovery_text: In high orbit around Ithra II hangs a station that predates human arrival by millennia. The Ithra claim it as heritage.

name: Junction Debris
effect: Remnants of ancient battles at this strategic junction. Some debris still drifts.
discovery_text: The space around Havor contains fragments of ships from multiple eras. This junction has been fought over many times.

name: The Veil
effect: Interstellar dust reduces long-range sensors. Ships sometimes arrive unexpectedly.
discovery_text: Dense dust between Fexon and the warplines makes long-range detection difficult. Ambushes are possible here.

name: The Spark
effect: Ancient navigation aid. Less functional than Koral marker but still active.
discovery_text: Just beyond Raxen II an ancient beacon gutters like a failing flame. It may have guided ships here millennia ago.
